image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black audio cassette tape resting on a white surface. The cassette features a transparent window revealing the internal spools and magnetic tape. There is an orange label with handwritten text 'PINK' visible through the top window, and two distinct orange stripes run horizontally across the front face. The plastic casing shows signs of wear and texture.
